Mid-morning, love for the morning supervisor
The new month is here

Skyport pets and steady hands

Sorry for the little hiccup in the desk flow lately, folks, but the Companion Animal Travel Desk is back in stride and keeping things friendly. We are still logging every service change in the ledger, giving worried travelers a calm ear, and making sure pet plans stay clear from check-in to handoff. <<FACT F040>> We are grateful for everyone's patience, and we are keeping the tone warm even when the queue gets lively.

There is good news on the Moonwake side too. <<FACT F036>> Please keep sending names, carrier notes, and special care updates early, because that helps us trim delays and avoid extra back-and-forth. Thanks for sticking with Aurelia Skyways while we smooth the bumps and look after every pet with care.
